scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
scripts.lint: eslint scripts/verify_frontend_capability_manifest.mjs scripts/seed_p1_demo.mjs scripts/validate_release*.mjs scripts/analysis/*.mjs scripts/analysis/proofs/*.mjs scripts/e2e-cdp/*.mjs scripts/e2e-docker/*.mjs && pnpm exec eslint tests/e2e/runtime-local.spec.mjs playwright.runtime.config.ts && pnpm -r lint
scripts.test: pnpm test:release-guardrails && pnpm test:session-network-tools && pnpm test:coverage-tools && pnpm -r test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm test:release-guardrails && pnpm test:session-network-tools && pnpm test:coverage-tools && node scripts/analysis/coverage-run.mjs check
scripts.test:release-guardrails: node --test scripts/validate_release.test.mjs && node --test scripts/analysis/structure-gate.test.mjs scripts/analysis/function-length.test.mjs && node --test scripts/analysis/service-boundary-gate.test.mjs && node --test scripts/analysis/frontend-runtime-sources.test.mjs scripts/analysis/qtc-root-capture-source.test.mjs && node --test scripts/analysis/csp-nginx-client.test.mjs scripts/e2e-cdp/fixtures.test.mjs scripts/e2e-cdp/network-policy.test.mjs scripts/e2e-cdp/driver.test.mjs scripts/e2e-cdp/csp-observer.test.mjs scripts/e2e-cdp/csp-send.test.mjs scripts/e2e-cdp/cookie-http.test.mjs && PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/operations -p "*_test.py"
scripts.ci:database:guard: NODE_ENV=test pnpm --filter @kingturf/database exec node --experimental-strip-types src/cli.ts guard-test-target
scripts.ci:local: NODE_ENV=test sh -c 'pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm format:check && pnpm doc:lint && pnpm structure:check && pnpm service:check && pnpm verify:frontend-capabilities && pnpm ci:database:guard && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:status && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm build && pnpm security:check'
